questions.question:
Which of the given values can x NOT take without changing the mode in the following data set?

{1, 2, 3, 3, 7, 8, 9, 3, 11, x, 17, 11, 13}
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Mode = most frequent value → currently 3 appears 3 times

Check closest competitor: 11 appears 2 times

If x = 11 → frequency of 11 becomes 3 → tie with 3

This changes uniqueness of mode

**∴ Answer = 11**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

{1, 2, 3, 3, 7, 8, 9, 3, 11, x, 17, 11, 13}

**Formula used:**

Mode = value with highest frequency

**Calculation:**

⇒ Frequency of 3 = 3

⇒ Frequency of 11 = 2

⇒ All others appear once

⇒ If x = 3 → frequency becomes 4 → mode remains 3

⇒ If x = 11 → frequency becomes 3 → two modes (3 and 11)

⇒ Mode changes (no longer unique)

**∴ The correct answer is 11.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Mode Concept

Mode is the value that appears most frequently in a dataset.

Unique vs Multiple Mode

If two values share highest frequency → bimodal set.

Effect of Adding One Value

Adding a number can increase its frequency and may change the mode.

Frequency Check Trick

Always compare highest and second-highest frequencies to predict changes.

questions.question: Two trains, 259 m and 231 m in length, are running in opposite directions. The first runs at the rate of 55 km/hr and the second at the rate of 71 km/hr. How long will they take to cross each other?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Opposite direction → speeds add

Total distance = 259 + 231 = 490 m

Relative speed = (55 + 71) = 126 km/hr = 126 × 5/18 = 35 m/s

Time = 490 ÷ 35 = 14 sec

**∴ Answer = 14 seconds**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length of first train = 259 m, second train = 231 m

Speed of first = 55 km/hr, second = 71 km/hr

**Formula used:**

Time = Total Distance ÷ Relative Speed

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total distance = 259 + 231 = 490 m

⇒ Relative speed = 55 + 71 = 126 km/hr

⇒ Convert speed: 126 × 5/18 = 35 m/s

⇒ Time = 490 ÷ 35 = 14 seconds

**∴ The correct answer is 14 seconds.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed

Opposite direction → speeds add, Same direction → speeds subtract.

Train Crossing Rule

When two trains cross, distance = sum of their lengths.

Unit Conversion

To convert km/hr to m/s → multiply by 5/18.

Basic Formula

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

questions.question: If 20% of a number is added to 78, then the result is the same number. 70% of the same number is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let number = x

Given: x − 20% of x = 78 → 80% of x = 78

x = 78 ÷ 0.8 = 97.5

70% of x = 0.7 × 97.5 = 68.25

**∴ Answer = 68.25**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

20% of a number + 78 = number

**Formula used:**

Percentage = (Part/Whole) × 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let the number = x

⇒ 20% of x + 78 = x

⇒ 0.2x + 78 = x

⇒ x − 0.2x = 78

⇒ 0.8x = 78

⇒ x = 78 ÷ 0.8 = 97.5

⇒ 70% of x = 0.7 × 97.5 = 68.25

**∴ The correct answer is 68.25.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage Basics

x% = x/100. So 20% = 0.2 and 70% = 0.7.

Forming Equations

Translate statements into equations carefully to solve unknown values.

Shortcut Idea

If a part is added to get the whole, subtract that part to simplify quickly.

Decimal Conversion

Use decimal form of percentages for faster calculation.

questions.question: The income of Raman is ₹43,500. He saves 17% of his income. If his income increases by 18% and expenditure increases by 20%, then his savings will:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Income = 43500, Savings = 17% → Expenditure = 83%

New income = 43500 × 1.18, New expenditure = 83% × 1.20

Net saving % = 118% − (83 × 1.20)% = 118 − 99.6 = 18.4%

Increase in saving % = 18.4 − 17 = 1.4%

**∴ Savings increase by 1.4% of original income = 609**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Income = 43500, Savings = 17%

**Formula used:**

Savings = Income − Expenditure

**Calculation:**

⇒ Initial savings = 17% of 43500 = 7395

⇒ Initial expenditure = 43500 − 7395 = 36105

⇒ New income = 43500 × 1.18 = 51330

⇒ New expenditure = 36105 × 1.20 = 43326

⇒ New savings = 51330 − 43326 = 8004

⇒ Increase in savings = 8004 − 7395 = 609

**∴ The savings increase by ₹609.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Income–Expenditure Relation

Savings = Income − Expenditure

Percentage Increase

New value = Original × (1 + % increase)

Saving Percentage Trick

If savings = x%, expenditure = (100 − x)%

Combined Effect

Always adjust both income and expenditure separately before subtracting.

questions.question: A person’s salary is first reduced by 30% and then increased by 40%. What is the overall percentage decrease in his salary?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use net effect formula: a − b − (ab/100)

Here decrease = 30%, increase = 40%

Net % change = 40 − 30 − (30 × 40)/100 = 10 − 12 = −2%

Negative means decrease

**∴ Answer = 2% decrease**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Salary reduced by 30% and then increased by 40%

**Formula used:**

Successive change = Original × (1 − a/100) × (1 + b/100)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let original salary = 100

⇒ After 30% decrease → 100 × 0.7 = 70

⇒ After 40% increase → 70 × 1.4 = 98

⇒ Final salary = 98

⇒ Decrease = 100 − 98 = 2

⇒ Percentage decrease = 2%

**∴ The correct answer is 2% decrease.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Percentage Change

Net change = a + b + (ab/100) for same direction, and a − b − (ab/100) for opposite direction.

Multiplicative Method

Final value = Initial × (1 − a/100) × (1 + b/100)

Common Mistake

Do not directly subtract percentages (40 − 30), always consider compounding effect.

Shortcut Insight

Opposite changes always include a negative cross term (ab/100).

questions.question:
The curved surface area of a cylinder of height 12 cm is 602.88 cm². If the radius of the cylinder is doubled and its height is increased by 25%, then find the ratio between the original volume to the new volume of the cylinder.

(Use pi = 3.14 )
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Volume ∝ r²h

Radius doubled → factor = 2² = 4

Height increased by 25% → factor = 1.25

New volume = 4 × 1.25 = 5 times original

**∴ Answer = 1 : 5**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Curved surface area = 602.88 cm², height = 12 cm

**Formula used:**

CSA = 2πrh, Volume = πr²h

**Calculation:**

⇒ 2 × 3.14 × r × 12 = 602.88

⇒ 75.36r = 602.88

⇒ r = 602.88 ÷ 75.36 = 8 cm

⇒ Original volume = 3.14 × 8² × 12

⇒ = 3.14 × 64 × 12 = 2411.52 cm³

⇒ New radius = 16 cm, new height = 12 × 1.25 = 15 cm

⇒ New volume = 3.14 × 16² × 15

⇒ = 3.14 × 256 × 15 = 12057.6 cm³

⇒ Ratio = 2411.52 : 12057.6

⇒ Divide both by 2411.52 → 1 : 5

**∴ The correct answer is 1 : 5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Cylinder Curved Surface Area

CSA = 2πrh

Volume of Cylinder

Volume = πr²h

Scaling Rule

Volume changes with square of radius and directly with height.

Percentage Increase

25% increase means multiplying by 1.25.

questions.question: A son's present age is two-fifths of the age of his father. After 8 years from now, his age will be one-half of the age of his father. How old (in years) is the father at present?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio now (son : father) = 2 : 5

After 8 years → (2x + 8) : (5x + 8) = 1 : 2

Cross multiply → 2(2x + 8) = 5x + 8

4x + 16 = 5x + 8 → x = 8

**∴ Father’s age = 5x = 40 years**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Son’s age = 2/5 of father’s age

After 8 years, son’s age = 1/2 of father’s age

**Formula used:**

Form linear equations based on age relations

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let father’s present age = F

⇒ Son’s present age = (2/5)F

⇒ After 8 years: Son = (2/5)F + 8, Father = F + 8

⇒ (2/5)F + 8 = (1/2)(F + 8)

⇒ Multiply both sides by 10

⇒ 4F + 80 = 5F + 40

⇒ 80 − 40 = 5F − 4F

⇒ F = 40

**∴ The father’s present age is 40 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Age Ratio Concept

Ages can be assumed in ratio form to simplify equations.

Linear Equations

Age problems are solved by forming and solving linear equations.

Future Age Relation

Add same number of years to both persons.

Cross Multiplication

Useful method to solve proportional equations quickly.

questions.question: A building casts a shadow of length 46 m, when the angle of elevation of the sun is 60º .Find the height of the building. (Use sqrt3=1.7)

questions.question: A woman travelled at a speed of 20 m/min for 80 min, and at a speed of 56 m/min for 64 min. Her average speed (in m/min) is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Average speed = Total distance ÷ Total time

Distance₁ = 20 × 80 = 1600 m, Distance₂ = 56 × 64 = 3584 m

Total distance = 1600 + 3584 = 5184 m

Total time = 80 + 64 = 144 min

**∴ Answer = 5184 ÷ 144 = 36 m/min**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed₁ = 20 m/min, Time₁ = 80 min; Speed₂ = 56 m/min, Time₂ = 64 min

**Formula used:**

Average speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time

**Calculation:**

⇒ Distance₁ = 20 × 80 = 1600 m

⇒ Distance₂ = 56 × 64 = 3584 m

⇒ Total distance = 1600 + 3584 = 5184 m

⇒ Total time = 80 + 64 = 144 min

⇒ Average speed = 5184 ÷ 144 = 36 m/min

**∴ The correct answer is 36 m/min.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Speed

Average speed = Total distance ÷ Total time

Distance Formula

Distance = Speed × Time

Unequal Time Case

When time differs, always compute total distance instead of using simple average.

Common Mistake

Do not take simple average of speeds unless time intervals are equal.

questions.question: The value of (5)/(14) times (14)/(frac{7){5} div (7)/(11) { of } 2(1)/(5)} is :

[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Cancel first: (5/14 × 14) = 5

Convert mixed number: 2 1/5 = 11/5

Inside: (7/5) ÷ (7/11 × 11/5) = (7/5) ÷ (7/5) = 1

So expression = 5 ÷ 1

**∴ Answer = 5**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

(5/14) × 14 ÷ [(7/5) ÷ (7/11) of 2 1/5]

**Concept Used:**

BODMAS rule

**Calculation:**

⇒ (5/14) × 14 ÷ [(7/5) ÷ (7/11) × 11/5]

⇒ (5/14) × 14 ÷ [(7/5) ÷ (77/55)]

⇒ (5/14) × 14 ÷ [(7/5) ÷ (7/5)]

⇒ (5/14) × 14 ÷ 1

⇒ 5 ÷ 1

⇒ 5

**∴ The correct answer is 5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

BODMAS Rule

Brackets → Orders → Division/Multiplication → Addition/Subtraction

Of Means Multiply

In such expressions, of is treated as multiplication.

Fraction Division

a/b ÷ c/d = a/b × d/c

Mixed Fraction

Convert mixed numbers into improper fractions before solving.

questions.question:
What is the value of *x* in the following equation?

x div 0.45 = 2660
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert the decimal value directly to a fraction to simplify the calculation:

0.45 = 45/100 = 9/20

x = 2660 × (9/20)

x = 133 × 9 = 1197

**∴ The correct answer is 1197.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

x ÷ 0.45 = 2660

**Calculations:**

⇒ x / 0.45 = 2660

⇒ x = 2660 × 0.45

⇒ x = 266 × 4.5

⇒ x = 133 × 9

⇒ x = 1197

**∴ The correct answer is 1197.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Decimal to Fraction Conversion

Converting standard decimals to their lowest fractional forms (e.g., 0.45 = 9/20, 0.75 = 3/4) often prevents calculation errors and speeds up simplification.

Multiplication by 9 Shortcut

To multiply any number by 9 quickly, simply multiply the number by 10 and subtract the original number (e.g., 133 × 9 = 1330 − 133 = 1197).

BODMAS Rule

Simplification always strictly follows the sequence: Brackets, Orders (powers and roots), Division, Multiplication, Addition, and Subtraction.

questions.question: A cricketer has an average of 62 runs over 5 innings. If he scores 296 runs in the 6th inning, by how many runs does his average score increase?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Net extra runs scored in the 6th inning = Score − Previous Average

⇒ Extra runs = 296 − 62 = 234

This extra score is distributed equally among all 6 innings.

⇒ Increase in average = 234 ÷ 6 = 39 runs

**∴ The correct answer is 39 runs.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average of 5 innings = 62 runs

Score in 6th inning = 296 runs

**Formula Used:**

Average = Sum of observations ÷ Total number of observations

 
• 5 Innings Avg: 62 6th Inning 296 runs 
• New Avg: 101 
• 
 + 39 runs 
 
 Extra 234 runs shared 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total runs in 5 innings = 62 × 5 = 310 runs

⇒ Total runs in 6 innings = 310 + 296 = 606 runs

⇒ New average = 606 ÷ 6 = 101 runs

⇒ Increase in average = 101 − 62 = 39 runs

**∴ The correct answer is 39 runs.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Net Deviation Method

When a new value is added to a group, New Average = Old Average + (Net Deviation ÷ New Total Number of Items). This eliminates the need for full multiplication when finding average changes.

Combined Average

If group 1 has n₁ items with average A₁ and group 2 has n₂ items with average A₂, the Combined Average = (n₁A₁ + n₂A₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).

Replacement in Average

If an item is replaced, Change in Total Value = Change in Average × Number of items. If the average increases, the new item has a higher value than the replaced one.

questions.question: In triangle ABC, BD perp AC at D and angle DBC = 14circ. E is a point on BC such that angle CAE = 75circ. What is the measure of angle AEB?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In right-angled ΔBDC, ∠C = 180° − (90° + 14°) = 76°.

In ΔACE, since B-E-C is a straight line, ∠AEB acts as the exterior angle at vertex E.

By the Exterior Angle Theorem, an exterior angle equals the sum of the two opposite interior angles.

⇒ ∠AEB = ∠C + ∠CAE

⇒ ∠AEB = 76° + 75° = 151°.

**∴ The correct answer is 151°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

BD ⊥ AC at D ⇒ ∠BDC = 90°

**Calculations:**

⇒ In right-angled ΔBDC, the sum of the angles is 180°.

⇒ ∠C = 180° − (∠BDC + ∠DBC)

⇒ ∠C = 180° − (90° + 14°) = 76°

⇒ Now, considering ΔACE, the sum of the angles is 180°.

⇒ ∠AEC = 180° − (∠C + ∠CAE)

⇒ ∠AEC = 180° − (76° + 75°)

⇒ ∠AEC = 180° − 151° = 29°

⇒ Since point E lies on the straight line segment BC, angles ∠AEB and ∠AEC form a linear pair.

⇒ ∠AEB + ∠AEC = 180°

⇒ ∠AEB = 180° − 29° = 151°

**∴ The correct answer is 151°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Exterior Angle Theorem

The exterior angle of a triangle is always equal to the sum of the two opposite interior angles. This helps in directly finding angles without calculating the third interior angle first.

Linear Pair Axiom

When two adjacent angles are formed by a pair of intersecting lines or on a straight line, their sum is exactly 180°.

Sum of Angles of a Triangle

The sum of all three interior angles in any Euclidean triangle always equals exactly 180°. In a right triangle, the two non-right angles sum up to exactly 90°.

 Marked Price (MP) = ₹4820 Selling Price (SP) = ₹4338 
 SP part (90%)

⇒ Discount = ₹482

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Marked Price & Discount

Discount is always calculated on the Marked Price (MP) of an item. The formula is Discount % = (Discount ÷ MP) × 100.

Successive Discounts

When two consecutive discounts d₁% and d₂% are offered, the equivalent single discount is given by the formula: (d₁ + d₂ − d₁d₂/100)%.

Relation Between CP and MP

A direct relationship exists between Cost Price (CP) and Marked Price (MP) using profit and discount percentages: CP / MP = (100 − Discount%) / (100 + Profit%).

questions.question: The length, breadth, and height of a rectangular box are in the ratio 8 : 7 : 5. If the volume of the box is 2240 cm³, find the total surface area (in cm², round off to the nearest tens) of the box.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let dimensions = 8x, 7x, 5x

Volume = 8x × 7x × 5x = 280x³ = 2240

x³ = 8 → x = 2

Dimensions = 16, 14, 10

**∴ TSA = 2(16×14 + 14×10 + 10×16) = 2(224 + 140 + 160) = 1048 ≈ 1050 cm²**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio of dimensions = 8 : 7 : 5, Volume = 2240 cm³

**Formula used:**

Volume = l × b × h, TSA = 2(lb + bh + hl)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let l = 8x, b = 7x, h = 5x

⇒ Volume = 8x × 7x × 5x = 280x³

⇒ 280x³ = 2240

⇒ x³ = 2240 ÷ 280 = 8

⇒ x = 2

⇒ l = 16, b = 14, h = 10

⇒ TSA = 2(16×14 + 14×10 + 10×16)

⇒ = 2(224 + 140 + 160)

⇒ = 2 × 524 = 1048 cm²

⇒ Rounded to nearest tens = 1050 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 1050 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Cuboid Volume

Volume = l × b × h

Total Surface Area

TSA = 2(lb + bh + hl)

Ratio Method

Assume dimensions as multiples of a common variable.

Rounding Rule

Nearest tens: check units digit (≥5 round up, else down).

questions.question: If three numbers are in the ratio 3 : 5 : 7 and their total sum is 510, what is the greatest number that can exactly divide all three numbers?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Sum of the ratio parts = 3 + 5 + 7 = 15

The common multiplier (x) = Total Sum ÷ Sum of parts = 510 ÷ 15 = 34.

The greatest number that exactly divides all three numbers is their Highest Common Factor (HCF).

Since the ratio components 3, 5, and 7 are co-prime, the HCF is exactly the common multiplier x.

**∴ The correct answer is 34.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Three numbers are in the ratio 3 : 5 : 7

Total sum of the numbers = 510

**Formula Used:**

Sum of numbers = Total given value

If numbers are ax, bx, and cx (where a, b, c are co-prime), their HCF = x

questions.question: A shopkeeper marks his goods at X% above the cost price and sells them at a discount of 35%. If he makes a profit of 69%, find the value of X.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Direct formula for ratio of Marked Price (MP) to Cost Price (CP):

MP ÷ CP = (100 + Profit%) ÷ (100 − Discount%)

MP ÷ CP = (100 + 69) ÷ (100 − 35) = 169 ÷ 65 = 13 ÷ 5

Markup amount = 13 − 5 = 8 parts over a base CP of 5 parts.

Markup % = (8 ÷ 5) × 100 = 160%

**∴ The correct answer is 160.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Profit percentage = 69%

Discount percentage = 35%

**Formula Used:**

Selling Price (SP) = CP × (100 + Profit%) ÷ 100

Selling Price (SP) = MP × (100 − Discount%) ÷ 100

 CP SP MP 
 
 Markup = X% 
 
 −35% (Discount) 
 
 +69% (Profit) 

**Calculations:**

Let the Cost Price (CP) be 100.

⇒ Selling Price (SP) = 100 × (100 + 69) ÷ 100 = 169

⇒ SP is also determined by applying a 35% discount on Marked Price (MP).

⇒ 169 = MP × (100 − 35) ÷ 100

⇒ 169 = MP × 65 ÷ 100

⇒ MP = 169 × 100 ÷ 65

⇒ MP = 13 × 100 ÷ 5 = 260

⇒ Markup amount = MP − CP = 260 − 100 = 160

⇒ Markup % (X) = (160 ÷ 100) × 100 = 160%

**∴ The correct answer is 160.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Marked Price & Cost Price Relation

The direct relation between MP and CP is given by: MP ÷ CP = (100 + P%) ÷ (100 − D%).

Successive Discount

For two successive discounts D₁% and D₂%, the equivalent single discount is given by (D₁ + D₂ − D₁×D₂ ÷ 100)%.

Dishonest Dealer Concept

When a seller uses false weights and sells at CP, Profit% = [(True Weight − False Weight) ÷ False Weight] × 100.

questions.question: If 8x² + 2y² + 18z² - 4xy - 6yz - 12zx = 0, then find x : y : z.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Try writing expression as sum of squares

8x² + 2y² + 18z² − 4xy − 6yz − 12zx = 2(2x − y)² + 2(y − 3z)²

For total = 0 → each square = 0

2x − y = 0 and y − 3z = 0

**∴ x : y : z = 1 : 2 : (2/3) = 3 : 6 : 2**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

8x² + 2y² + 18z² − 4xy − 6yz − 12zx = 0

**Formula used:**

Convert quadratic expression into sum of squares

**Calculation:**

⇒ 8x² + 2y² − 4xy = 2(2x − y)²

⇒ 2y² + 18z² − 6yz = 2(y − 3z)²

⇒ So given expression = 2(2x − y)² + 2(y − 3z)²

⇒ For sum = 0 → each term = 0

⇒ 2x − y = 0 ⇒ y = 2x

⇒ y − 3z = 0 ⇒ y = 3z

⇒ From y = 2x and y = 3z

⇒ 2x = 3z ⇒ x : y : z = x : 2x : (2x/3)

⇒ Multiply by 3 → 3 : 6 : 2

**∴ The correct answer is 3 : 6 : 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Sum of Squares Principle

If sum of squares = 0, then each square must be zero.

Perfect Square Identity

(a − b)² = a² + b² − 2ab

Ratio Formation

Convert variables into proportional form to get ratio.

Homogeneous Equation

All terms have same degree, so ratio method works.

questions.question: Rizwan buys 3 watches, all with the same price, for a total of ₹4,800. He sells the first at a profit of ₹200, the second at a loss of ₹100, and the third at a profit of ₹150. What is the overall profit or loss percentage? (Round off to two decimal places)
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total CP = 4800 (equal prices → no need to split)

Net profit = 200 − 100 + 150 = 250

Profit % = (250 / 4800) × 100

= 5.2083 ≈ 5.21%

**∴ Answer = 5.21% profit**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total cost of 3 watches = 4800

**Formula used:**

Profit % = (Net Profit ÷ Total Cost Price) × 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ Cost price of each watch = 4800 ÷ 3 = 1600

⇒ SP₁ = 1600 + 200 = 1800

⇒ SP₂ = 1600 − 100 = 1500

⇒ SP₃ = 1600 + 150 = 1750

⇒ Total SP = 1800 + 1500 + 1750 = 5050

⇒ Net profit = 5050 − 4800 = 250

⇒ Profit % = (250 ÷ 4800) × 100 = 5.21%

**∴ The correct answer is 5.21% profit.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Profit & Loss

Profit = SP − CP, Loss = CP − SP

Overall Profit

Net result = sum of all individual profits and losses

Percentage Formula

Profit % = (Profit ÷ Total CP) × 100

Equal Cost Trick

When CPs are equal, directly add profits and losses.
